description: This file defines the 'PackingSession' class, which manages the packing process within an order shipment workflow in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles tasks like adding items to packages, creating shipment and package records, issuing items to shipments, calculating weights and costs, and managing packing events.

classes.name: PackingSession
classes.description: Manages the packing workflow for order shipments, including item addition, shipment creation, weight calculations, and event handling.

inner_classes.name: ItemDisplay
inner_classes.description: A helper class representing display info for items in the packing session, including product ID, quantity, and related order item data.

methods.name: addOrIncreaseLine
methods.description: Adds a new item line or increases the quantity for an existing line in the packing session, handling inventory reservation checks.

methods.name: findLine
methods.description: Finds a specific line in the packing session based on order and product details.

methods.name: createPackLineItem
methods.description: Creates a new packing line item, updating package weights and number.

methods.name: getPackedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates the total quantity of a product packed in the session, filtered by various criteria.

methods.name: checkLineForAdd
methods.description: Checks if a line can accommodate additional quantity, considering inventory reservations.

methods.name: createShipment
methods.description: Creates a shipment record based on the packing session context.

methods.name: issueItemsToShipment
methods.description: Issues packed items to the associated shipment, updating shipment records.

methods.name: createPackages
methods.description: Creates package entities within the shipment based on the current packing session.

methods.name: applyItemsToPackages
methods.description: Associates packed items with their respective shipment packages.

methods.name: updateShipmentRouteSegments
methods.description: Updates the total weight info of shipment route segments based on packed items.

methods.name: setPickerOnPicklist
methods.description: Assigns a picker role to the picklist.

methods.name: getTotalWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of all packed items.
